scope.capability: single-speed gyroscopic modal analysis of a bounded linear BEAM2 rotor with centered rigid axisymmetric disks
scope.perturbation: small linear perturbations about the undeformed, unprestressed state
allowed_structure: isotropic circular sections with constant section properties per element
one common global rotation axis parallel to the beam centerline
centered rigid axisymmetric disks attached at existing beam nodes
fixed-ground linear springs only when their assembled contribution passes the same SPD checks
explicitly_rejected: non-BEAM2 or mixed structural element families
branched, curved, or non-collinear beam centerlines
generic concentrated mass at a disk node
nonzero damping or nonzero static/prestress load
MPC, RBE, contact, or unsupported constraint transforms
forced unbalance response or nonlinear rotor behavior
PETSc, SLEPc, MPI, or sparse QEP

geometry_and_section_preflight.shaft_topology: one connected unbranched path with every BEAM2 edge collinear
geometry_and_section_preflight.shaft_length: sum of unique path segment lengths; finite and strictly positive
geometry_and_section_preflight.spin_axis_alignment: abs(dot(unit shaft direction, unit rotation axis)) >= 1-1e-12
geometry_and_section_preflight.disk_axis_alignment: dot(unit disk axis, unit rotation axis) >= 1-1e-12; opposite direction is rejected rather than silently changing sign
geometry_and_section_preflight.circular_isotropic_section: each used beam material must be beam_isotropic, Iy and Iz equal within 1e-12 relative to max(abs(Iy),abs(Iz)), and J=Iy+Iz within 1e-12 relative
geometry_and_section_preflight.section_properties: material properties must be finite and positive, including density; section properties are constant within each element and may differ between elements
geometry_and_section_preflight.loads_and_initial_state: nonzero nodal/distributed loads, contact, and any prestress/initial-stress state are rejected; the solver does not silently ignore them

out_of_scope_work_packages: WP06 Campbell, speed sweep, modal tracking, and plotting

scientific_convention.gyroscopic_matrix_definition: G is the unit-speed gyroscopic matrix and does not contain Omega
scientific_convention.rotation_sign: signed Omega is applied exactly once by the QEP; axis direction follows the global right-hand rule
scientific_convention.disk_mass_block: m*I for translations and Jd*(I-a*a.T)+Jp*(a*a.T) for rotations; zero translation/rotation coupling

rotation_configuration.axis_policy: finite nonzero 3-vector normalized on construction; direction is retained
rotation_configuration.speed_policy: finite signed scalar in rad/s; zero is valid
rotation_configuration.rpm_policy: only an explicit RotationConfig.from_rpm API may convert RPM; input parsing never guesses units

discrete_ownership_and_preflight.entity: RotatingDisk stored in the existing concentrated-mass collection
discrete_ownership_and_preflight.mass_owner: one disk entity contributes translational and rotary mass exactly once through GlobalAssembler
discrete_ownership_and_preflight.gyro_owner: RotatingDiskGyroAssembler contributes G only; it never multiplies by Omega
discrete_ownership_and_preflight.duplicate_mass_rule: reject a generic ConcentratedMass at any RotatingDisk node before K/M/G allocation
discrete_ownership_and_preflight.all_discrete_entities_rule: route-local validator examines every spring and mass even when finite elements are present
discrete_ownership_and_preflight.other_routes: reject RotatingDisk before assembly on every analysis other than rotating_modal

assembly_and_reduction.K_and_M: reuse existing structural assembly and discrete mass/spring path
assembly_and_reduction.G: assemble once from disk rotational blocks in the same global DofManager order
assembly_and_reduction.constraints: homogeneous fixed DOFs only; select the same free-index vector for M, K, and G

reduced_invariants.M: finite, real, symmetric and positive definite
reduced_invariants.K: finite, real, symmetric and positive definite
reduced_invariants.shape_and_order: M, K, G have identical reduced shape and index ordering

qep_solver.root_policy: all raw 2*n roots retained; any non-finite root/vector, malformed shape, or rejected residual fails closed

scaling.length_reference: L_ref is the end-to-end projected length of the validated straight beam chain; it must be finite and positive
scaling.coordinate_transform: q_physical = D*q_scaled; D is diagonal with L_ref for each translational DOF and 1 for each rotational DOF
scaling.matrix_norm: Frobenius norm, computed deterministically as sqrt(sum(A_ij*A_ij)) on the symmetric/reduced real matrices
scaling.reconstruction: phi_physical=D*phi_hat; lambda_physical=omega_ref*mu; all reported residuals and normalization use physical reduced M/K/G and lambda/Omega

result_contract.normalization: each returned mode satisfies phi.conj().T*M*phi=1 within the frozen tolerance; deterministic phase sets the largest-magnitude component real nonnegative without affecting phase-invariant comparisons
result_contract.complex_serialization: every complex scalar/vector is encoded explicitly as {real,imag}; round-trip must preserve complex values
result_contract.physical_mode_selection: select roots with positive imaginary part above 64*machine_epsilon*max(omega_ref,abs(lambda)); order by frequency_hz, then real(lambda), then imag(lambda); return requested count while retaining the full raw spectrum and indices
result_contract.pairing: no cross-speed tracking or branch IDs in WP05
result_contract.whirl: not classified in WP05 unless an independently defined diagnostic is available; otherwise NOT_DEFINED

frozen_tolerances.conservative_growth_ratio_definition: max_i(abs(real(lambda_i))/max(omega_ref,abs(lambda_i))) over the complete finite raw spectrum
frozen_tolerances.normalized_spectral_pair_mismatch_defini: minimum-cost full assignment between raw lambda and conjugate(raw lambda), with cost abs(lambda_i-conj(lambda_j))/max(omega_ref,abs(lambda_i),abs(lambda_j)); report maximum assigned cost
frozen_tolerances.symmetry_definition: norm_F(A-A.T)/max(norm_F(A),tiny) for M/K and norm_F(G+G.T)/max(norm_F(G),tiny) for G
frozen_tolerances.positive_definiteness: Cholesky factorization succeeds for each reduced symmetric M and K; no threshold tuning after observing a case
frozen_tolerances.generalized_eigenvalue_condition_definit: for each scaled generalized pencil root, ||left||2*||B*right||2/abs(left.conj().T*B*right); zero denominator or non-finite estimate is rejected

GYRO-01.purpose: Omega=0 recovers classic modal frequencies and eigenspaces for identical physical K/M including disk mass
GYRO-01.comparison: frequency and multiplicity agreement; compare phase-invariant modal assurance and degenerate subspaces; compare mass normalization and residuals
GYRO-01.oracle: classic ModalAnalysisSolver on a reference model with equivalent concentrated inertia and identical assembled K/M

GYRO-02.purpose: local disk matrices, assembly, frame covariance, sign and ownership

GYRO-03.purpose: independent analytical gyroscopic disk oscillator oracle
GYRO-03.oracle: omega0=sqrt(k_theta/Jd); s=Omega*Jp/Jd; unordered frequency pair is sqrt(omega0^2+(s/2)^2) +/- abs(s)/2
GYRO-03.independence: fixture computes the closed-form oracle directly and must not call production disk G assembly

GYRO-04.purpose: single-speed spectral splitting under signed spin
checks: splitting increases with absolute speed in analytic fixture
signed speed produces the expected unordered spectrum

dense_characterization.fixture: deterministically generated finite SPD M/K and finite skew G; generation seed and parameters recorded in each schema-v2 execution record
dense_characterization.stop_rule: before each size, estimate required dense matrices/workspace from prior measured RSS-per-linearized-DOF; skip a larger size if projected peak exceeds 70 percent of available physical memory or if the preceding size fails; never extrapolate a public bound above the largest size completed successfully
dense_characterization.supported_dof_bound_rule: at most the largest successfully completed target size, reduced by one target tier if its peak RSS exceeds 50 percent of available physical memory or any repetition has a residual/solve failure
dense_characterization.not_a_claim: no general HPC, sparse, parallel, or untested-size claim

evidence_records.schema: WP03 schema v2 execution identity and safe-resume contract

fast_development: QEP and result tests as implemented
pr_required_exact_wp05_sha: legacy non-regression tests selected from WP01
Ruff and type gates currently required by repository workflow
